blurb: Bayride Tours operates sightseeing cruises and mansion tours in Miami, focusing on the luxurious lifestyle of Miami's elite. Their 90-minute Mansions of Miami Beach Sightseeing Cruise offers views of Biscayne Bay, Miami's skyline, Port of Miami, Fisher Island, and Miami Beach mansions. Tours include knowledgeable guides in English and Spanish and options to enjoy the tour from climate-controlled or open-air decks.
